about: Men made by image-to-3D (tools/characters/): what the image model paints for each (what), and boxes of docs/concept/saloon-night.png shown to it as who he is (refs, [x0, y0, x1, y1]). Characters are built in layers (docs/DESTRUCTION_BRIEF.md part 5): a `from` entry is painted from that character's finished front picture instead of the concept painting, `change` says what to redraw (the body piece: hat and coat off), `hatless` fixes the turnaround's words, and an `item` entry is one garment alone on an invisible ghost mannequin (modelled by Tripo unrigged; tools/blender/fit_tripo.py fits it over the body). A `given` entry's front is a picture made outside the pipeline (Sean's, full length in the A-pose): it is kept as it is and only the other three views are painted. `back_of` says what his back shows when it isn't a coat and long hair.

stranger.what: a weathered frontier gunman of about forty in 1882: a dark brown wide-brimmed hat with a dented crown and a studded band, long dark hair to his collar, deep-set dark eyes, heavy brows, a thick dark drooping moustache and stubble (no beard), a white shirt with a turned-down collar, a dark necktie, a patterned dark vest, a heavy dark-brown wool frock coat to his knees, dark trousers, a cartridge belt and holster, worn brown boots

stranger_body.what: the same weathered frontier gunman bare-headed and without his coat: long dark hair to his collar, deep-set dark eyes, heavy brows, a thick dark drooping moustache and stubble (no beard), a white shirt with a turned-down collar, a dark necktie, a patterned dark vest, dark trousers, a cartridge belt and holster, worn brown boots
stranger_body.change: Take his hat and his frock coat off him: he is bare-headed, his long dark hair falling to his collar, in his white shirt with its turned-down collar, his dark necktie and patterned dark vest, dark trousers, cartridge belt with holster and worn brown boots. Keep his face, hair, moustache and everything else exactly as they are.

stranger_coat.item: his heavy dark-brown wool frock coat to the knees, open down the front, with its lapels and sleeves
stranger_coat.pose: The sleeves are held straight out and down at 45 degrees from the body, exactly as the man holds his arms standing in his A-pose, not hanging at the sides.
stranger_coat.what: a heavy dark-brown wool frock coat of 1882 to the knees, open down the front, lapels, long sleeves

stranger_hat.item: his dark brown wide-brimmed hat with a dented crown and a studded band
stranger_hat.what: a dark brown wide-brimmed felt hat of 1882 with a dented crown and a studded leather band

kid.what: a nervous young outlaw of about nineteen in 1882, thin, freckled and clean-shaven: a battered pale tan felt cowboy hat grimy with dark stains, its leather band blotched, its brim curled up at both sides, shaggy brown hair over his ears, a faded red bandana, a faded blue work shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, brown leather braces, a cartridge belt with a holster on his right hip, brown canvas trousers and worn brown boots
kid.back_of: the back of his hat, his blue shirt and his braces crossing his back

kid_body.what: the same nervous young outlaw bare-headed: short brown hair, a little tousled, freckled and clean-shaven, a faded red bandana, a faded blue work shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, brown leather braces, a cartridge belt with a holster on his right hip, brown canvas trousers and worn brown boots
kid_body.change: Take his hat off him: he is bare-headed, his short brown hair showing, cut short and a little tousled, a few strands over his forehead. Keep his young face (a lad of nineteen, freckled and grimy), bandana, shirt, braces, belt, holster, trousers, boots and everything else exactly as they are.
kid_body.back_of: the back of his bare head with its short brown hair, his blue shirt and his braces crossing his back
